Question ID: ENV_U03_L04_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ENV.POP.03

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Human Population and Resource Use
Stimulus: Human impact/resource data stimulus

A student reviews the required environmental evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Read the population graph or table. Then use the required stimulus (Human impact/resource data stimulus) to connect the visible evidence to population structure, population change, and carrying capacity. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ENV.POP.03 and avoids the common mistake: thinking population size changes for one reason only.
